//: Typecheck the Flow B compiler (aot/), the asset bakers (assets/), hot reload (hotreload/) and the package-root scripts. Its .mts files are checked strictly; a .mjs file is read only for the types it exports, unless it opts in with // @ts-check. Node runs the .mts files directly by stripping their types, so only erasable syntax is allowed (no enums, namespaces or parameter properties), a relative import names the real file (./x.mts), and a type-only import is written `import type`. svg-ops is checked the same way. The JavaScript the compiler imports from src/ is listed so this project (composite, for the references in tsconfig.json) can read it. Run with `npm run typecheck`.
